title: Backend Software Engineer
raw_description: We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our small platform team. You must have at least 3 years of professional experience with Python and have shipped production REST APIs. Strong SQL skills and experience with FastAPI or a comparable framework are essential. You'll design and maintain services backed by PostgreSQL. Experience with Docker is required for our containerised deployment pipeline. Familiarity with React is a bonus if you want to help out on the frontend occasionally, but is not required. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred but not mandatory - we care more about demonstrated ability. Must have full working rights in Australia.
